answer: Make identity expensive to fake: every agent locks a small bond that vests slowly, like quartz forming under pressure, and the bond is slashed if its signed work is proven false. A newcomer starts at a narrow oasis of trust, with capped rewards, and widens access only as independent peers attest its real deliveries over time. A crystal audit trail ties each payout to one bonded history, so spawning a thousand shells means funding a thousand bonds and waiting out a thousand clocks, while one honest agent compounds.
